viewsWelcome.libraryManagerHint:
Further libraries can be installed or re-installed in the Library Manager below.

Available libraries and their install (and import) commands can be found in the 'OCP CAD Viewer' preferences of VS Code.
config.view.tree_width: OCP CAD Viewer navigation tree width (default: 240)
config.view.glass: Use glass mode with transparent navigation tree (default: true)
config.view.new_tree_behavior: With the new behaviour the eye controls both icons, the mesh icon only the mesh behavior (default: true)
config.view.orbit_control: Use 'orbit' control mode instead of 'trackball' (default: false)
config.view.axes0: Show axes at the origin (0, 0, 0) (default: true)
config.view.grid_XY: Show grid on XY plane (default: false)
config.view.grid_YZ: Show grid on YZ plane (default: false)
config.view.grid_XZ: Show grid on XZ plane (default: false)
config.view.center_grid: Show grid planes crossing at center of object or global origin(default: false)
config.view.collapse: leaves: collapse all leaf nodes, all: collapse all nodes, none: expand all nodes, root: expand root only (default: leaves)
config.view.grid_font_size: Font size of the grid axis labels (default: 12)
config.view.language: 3D view interface language: auto follows the VS Code display language; en English; zh-CN Chinese. Changes apply immediately to an open viewer.
config.view.reset_camera: Reset camera (angle and zoom) between show commands
config.view.modifier_keys: Mapping of the viewer's modifier keys shift, ctrl, meta and alt to the keyboard's (shiftKey, ctrlKey, metaKey, altKey), one map per platform: 'macOS', and 'default' for Windows and Linux, where the Windows/Super key (metaKey) belongs to the desktop and meta is Alt instead. The extension applies the map for the platform it runs on, so a synced settings.json serves every machine.
config.render.default_color: Default shape color, CSS3 color names are allowed (default: #e8b024)
config.render.default_edgecolor: Default color of the edges of shapes, CSS3 color names are allowed (default: #707070)
config.render.default_thickedgecolor: Default color of lines, CSS3 color names are allowed (default: MediumOrchid)
config.render.default_facecolor: Default color of faces, CSS3 color names are allowed (default: Violet)
config.render.default_vertexcolor: Default color of vertices, CSS3 color names are allowed (default: MediumOrchid)
config.render.python_enumeration: Number repeated object names from 0 like Python indices - Solid(0), Solid(1), ... instead of Solid, Solid(2), ... The names are the tree paths that animations, states and selections use; false restores the former names (default: true)
config.advanced.watchCommands: Command to be executed when debugger halts. Needs to include locals()
config.advanced.watchByDefault: Whether to have visual debugging (OCP 3939·DEBUG) as the default or not
config.advanced.autostart: Whether to start the viewer when opening Python files or not
config.advanced.autostartTriggers: Trigger statements to start the viewer when opening Python files
config.advanced.autohideTerminal: Whether to autohide the Terminal on viewer start or not
config.advanced.initialPort: The start port where OCP CAD Viewer will start to search for a free port
config.advanced.shellCommandPrefix: Prefix for shell commands executed by the extension (e.g. ' ' to prevent shell history entries)
config.advanced.quickstartCommands: Shell commands to install the quickstart recipes. The values for placeholders {python}, {conda_env}, {ocp_vscode_version} will be replaced accordingly during execution
config.advanced.installCommands: Shell commands to install Python libraries. The values for placeholders {python}, {pip-install}, {ocp_vscode_version}, and {unset_conda} will be replaced accordingly during execution
config.advanced.codeSnippets: Python snippets to import the Python libraries
config.advanced.exampleDownloads: Github download path for repository zip archives
config.snippets.dotVscodeSnippets: Python snippets to help writing CAD code
config.advanced.terminalDelay: Delay until terminal command is started (default: 1000)
config.advanced.autostartDelay: Delay until autostart tries to refresh viewer and library manager at VS Code start (default: 250)
